decision_rationale: The paper describes a pipeline to encode synthetic omic data and then align pre-trained FMs on it, rather than proposing a new generative text-bio foundation model. The foundation-model aspect is present in the use of "pre-trained FMs," but the candidate contribution is a wrapper/workflow.
